title: So as not to, for fear of, lest
summary: Nói mục đích và tránh điều gì: so as (not) to, in order (not) to, for fear of/that, in case, lest (rất trang trọng).

dialogue.vi: Sao bạn nói thì thầm vậy?

dialogue.en: [[So as not to]] wake the baby.
dialogue.vi: Để không làm em bé thức giấc.

dialogue.en: And why did you take the stairs?
dialogue.vi: Thế sao bạn đi cầu thang bộ?

dialogue.en: [[For fear of]] getting stuck in the lift again.
dialogue.vi: Vì sợ lại bị kẹt trong thang máy.

dialogue.en: I always carry a torch [[in case]] the power goes out.
dialogue.vi: Mình luôn mang đèn pin phòng khi mất điện.

dialogue.en: Good idea. I'll write it down [[lest]] I forget.
dialogue.vi: Ý hay. Mình ghi lại kẻo quên.

sections.heading: So as (not) to, in order (not) to
sections.rule: **so as to / in order to + V** = để (trang trọng hơn to). Phủ định: **so as not to / in order not to** (không dùng *not to* đơn thuần ở đầu câu).

examples.en: We left early [[so as to]] avoid traffic.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đi sớm để tránh kẹt xe.

examples.en: He spoke quietly [[so as not to]] disturb anyone.
examples.vi: Anh ấy nói khẽ để không làm phiền ai.

examples.en: [[In order not to]] miss the bus, she ran.
examples.vi: Để không lỡ xe buýt, cô ấy chạy.

check.explain: Phủ định: so as not to.

sections.heading: For fear of + V-ing / for fear that + mệnh đề
sections.rule: **for fear of + V-ing / danh từ** và **for fear (that) + S + might/would** = vì sợ (điều xấu xảy ra).

examples.en: She didn't speak [[for fear of]] making mistakes.
examples.vi: Cô ấy không nói vì sợ mắc lỗi.

examples.en: He hid the letter [[for fear that]] his wife might read it.
examples.vi: Anh ấy giấu lá thư vì sợ vợ đọc được.

check.prompt: They stayed inside for fear ___ catching a cold.

sections.heading: In case + hiện tại, lest + V nguyên mẫu
sections.rule: **in case + hiện tại đơn** = phòng khi. **lest + S + (should) + V** = kẻo, để khỏi (rất trang trọng, văn viết).

examples.en: Take a coat [[in case]] it gets cold.
examples.vi: Mang áo khoác phòng khi trời lạnh.

examples.en: We must act now [[lest]] it be too late.
examples.vi: Chúng ta phải hành động ngay kẻo quá muộn.

check.prompt: Bring some cash in case the card machine ___.

mistakes.wrong: I whispered so as to not wake him.
mistakes.right: I whispered so as not to wake him.

mistakes.wrong: He didn't call for fear to disturb her.
mistakes.right: He didn't call for fear of disturbing her.

mistakes.wrong: Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
mistakes.right: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

mistakes.wrong: We left early in order to not miss the train.
mistakes.right: We left early in order not to miss the train.

mistakes.wrong: Speak softly lest you would wake the baby.
mistakes.right: Speak softly lest you wake the baby.

answers: She left early so as not to miss the bus.

exercises.sentence: He didn't speak for fear to make a mistake.
answers: He didn't speak for fear of making a mistake.

answers: Take a map in case you get lost.

exercises.vi: Cô ấy nói khẽ để không đánh thức em bé.
answers: She spoke quietly so as not to wake the baby.
She spoke softly so as not to wake the baby.
She spoke quietly in order not to wake the baby.

answers: He didn't dare to speak for fear of being laughed at.
